description.value: A beachfront hotel in the heart of Sechelt on BC's Sunshine Coast, formerly known as the Driftwood Motor Inn and now operating as Sechelt Inn under Catalog Hospitality. The property offers simple rooms with ocean views and a fully renovated penthouse suite with rooftop patio overlooking the water. An in-house restaurant, Fred's, serves handmade pasta, hearth-fired pizzas, and coastal mains just off the lobby.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at driftwoodmotorinn.com clearly shows the business now operates as 'Sechelt Inn' under Catalog Hospitality, indicating a rebrand from the OSM-listed name. Phone (604-885-5811) and address (5454 Trail Ave, Sechelt) match between OSM and the website, but the email has changed from info@driftwoodmotorinn.com to info@secheltinn.com. The website contains no cyclist-specific amenity information; the only confirmed optional amenity is on-site evening food via the in-house restaurant Fred's.
concerns: Business has been rebranded: OSM lists 'The Driftwood Inn' but the website clearly presents the current name as 'Sechelt Inn' (owned by Catalog Hospitality). OSM name and record should be updated.
OSM email (info@driftwoodmotorinn.com) is outdated; current contact email shown on website is info@secheltinn.com.

OSM community tag says 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt is on the Sunshine Coast (mainland side), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands — community classification may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating beachfront hotel in Sechelt confirmed active by current website content; a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.
enrichment_extras.notes: The driftwoodmotorinn.com URL remains functional and redirects to current Sechelt Inn content. The rebrand appears complete based on website branding, footer copyright (2026), and email domain change.
